name: Duck Breast
siboNotes: Plain duck breast is excellent for SIBO as it contains no fermentable carbohydrates and provides high-quality protein for gut healing.
preparationTips: Score the skin in a crosshatch pattern before cooking to render fat properly
Start cooking skin-side down in a cold pan to slowly render the fat
Avoid high-FODMAP marinades containing garlic or onion
Season with low-FODMAP herbs like rosemary, thyme, or sage
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
